definitions.gloss: lounge; conversation room; common room; sitting room
definitions.explanation: A room designated for relaxation and conversation, typically found in hotels, hospitals, dormitories, and other institutions. A shared space where people can sit, talk, and socialize.

examples.japanese: {談話室|だんわしつ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦コーヒー→コーヒー：00789_koohii⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飲|の}む→飲む：00322_nomu⟧。
examples.english: To drink coffee in the lounge.

examples.japanese: ⟦{病院|びょういん}→病院：00577_byouin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{談話室|だんわしつ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{話|はな}した→話す：00467_hanasu⟧。
examples.english: I talked with my family in the hospital lounge.

examples.japanese: ⟦{寮|りょう}→寮：03800_ryou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{談話室|だんわしつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦テレビ→テレビ：01536_terebi⟧や⟦ソファ→ソファ：04485_sofa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{置|お}かれていて→置く：01092_oku⟧、⟦{学生|がくせい}→学生：00610_gakusei⟧たち⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{憩|いこ}い⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{場|ば}→場：03699_ba⟧になっている。
examples.english: The dormitory lounge has a TV and sofas, and serves as a place of relaxation for students.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{談話|だんわ}→談話：20090_danwa⟧ (conversation, discussion) and ⟦{室|しつ}→室：09946_shitsu⟧ (room). Found in buildings where people stay for extended periods — hospitals, hotels, dormitories, retirement homes, and conference facilities.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{病院|びょういん}→病院：00577_byouin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{談話室|だんわしつ}: hospital lounge
- ⟦{寮|りょう}→寮：03800_ryou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{談話室|だんわしつ}: dormitory common room
- ⟦ホテル→ホテル：01027_hoteru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{談話室|だんわしつ}: hotel lounge
- {談話室|だんわしつ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{休|やす}む→休む：00606_yasumu⟧: to rest in the lounge

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ラウンジ→ラウンジ：29687_raunji⟧: lounge — loanword, used for upscale or commercial settings (airport lounges, hotel lounges)
- ⟦{休憩室|きゅうけいしつ}→休憩室：23410_kyuukeishitsu⟧: break room, rest room — a room for resting, often in workplaces
- ⟦{待合室|まちあいしつ}→待合室：07373_machiaishitsu⟧: waiting room — specifically for waiting, not socializing
- ⟦{応接室|おうせつしつ}→応接室：20242_ousetsushitsu⟧: reception room — a more formal room for receiving guests
